main_text.p: Martini Bracarensis Episcopi Collectio Orientalium Canonum, adscriptis ad margines tum variis lectionibus, tum fontibus ex quibus Canones illi deprom500pti sunt, curâ & studio Joan. Doviatii sacrorum canonum Professoris Regii, nunc primùm edita.

page.notes: Page is a single text column; the printed page number 446 and running head HISTORIA are at the top. Some words are blurred in the scan (e.g. "Pontificum", "Crisconium"); the word "depromptí" in the Doviatii sentence is partly obscured and was read as "depromptì sunt"; the line "deprom500pti" contains a misread artefact and should read "depromptì" [?]. Signature at lower right reads roughly "I ɜ" [?].
